stories.event: Americans voted on 3 Nov; results were not known at the time of writing and the morning run updates this. AP declares the House at 218 seats and the Senate at 51, or 50 for the vice-president's party. In 2022 it took eight days for the House and four for the Senate; in 2018 its copy had both by the small hours of the next day. Alaska's ranked-choice Senate count and California's late mail can hold a call past the window.

claims.label: AP calls the House by 5 Nov
claims.text: AP declares between 00:00 ET on 4 November and 23:59 ET on 5 November 2026 that one party has won control of the US House of Representatives (218 seats).
claims.criterion: YES if, between 00:00 ET on 4 Nov and 23:59 ET on 5 Nov 2026, the Associated Press declares that the Democratic or the Republican Party has won a majority in the House in the elections of 3 Nov 2026, or, if AP makes no explicit declaration, if AP race calls bring one party to at least 218 of the 435 seats in that time.
